name: Mammoth Hide (MTT)
body:
Price 8,165 gp; Slot armor; CL 6th; Weight 30 lbs.; Aura moderate abjuration and transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This +2 hide armor is made from woolly mammoth hide.

It seems to move with and bolster the wearer, and has only a –1 armor check penalty. Once per round, when the wearer makes a successful charge attack, the mammoth hide deals an additional 3d6 points of damage to the target. This damage isn’t multiplied on a critical hit or by effects that multiply the damage of a charge, such as Spirited Charge. Mammoth hide also protects the wearer from cold environments as the endure elements spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,165 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells bull’s strength, endure elements
